question: What if I reduce my dining out by 20%?
title: Spending less

cells.title: What a cut does to a usual month
cells.code:
CAT, PCT = "§CATEGORY§", float(§PCT§)
SAY = {"Restaurants": ("eating out", "Eating out", "Eating out"), "Groceries": ("groceries", "Groceries", "Groceries"), "Transportation": ("getting around", "Getting around", "Getting around"), "Entertainment": ("fun", "Fun", "Fun"), "Lifestyle": ("shopping", "Shopping", "Shopping"), "Travel": ("trips", "Trips", "Trips")}
w = kori.what_if([{"type": "cut", "target": CAT, "pct": PCT}])
c = w["changes"][0]
now, after = (w.get("left_over") or {}).get("now"), (w.get("left_over") or {}).get("after")
emit("cut_pct", PCT, "pct", "The cut")
emit("from_monthly", round(c["from_monthly"], 2), "eur_per_month", "A usual month now")
emit("to_monthly", round(c["to_monthly"], 2), "eur_per_month", "A usual month after the cut")
emit("monthly_effect", round(w["monthly_effect"], 2), "eur_per_month", "More left a month")
emit("yearly_effect", round(w["yearly_effect"], 2), "eur", "More left over a year")
emit("what", SAY[CAT][2], "text", "What is cut")
if now is not None and after is not None:
    emit("left_after_abs", round(abs(after), 2), "eur_per_month", "A usual month then leaves")
    emit("left_after_label", "left a month" if after >= 0 else "short a month", "text", "What the figure is")
    emit("left_now_abs", round(abs(now), 2), "eur_per_month", "Today")
    emit("left_now_label", "Today a usual month leaves" if now >= 0 else "Today a usual month is short by", "text", "Today")
if w.get("series"):
    table("series", w["series"], "Left over, added up month by month")

if now is not None and after is not None and w.get("series") and not w.get("partial_view") and c["from_monthly"] > 0 and w["monthly_effect"] > 0:
    say(f"Cutting {SAY[CAT][0]} by {num(PCT, 0)}% leaves **{eur(w['monthly_effect'])} more a month**, {eur(w['yearly_effect'])} over a year." + (f" A usual month would then leave {eur(after)}." if after >= 0 else f" A usual month would still be {eur(-after)} short."))
